description: This source file defines a class 'UndoDisbursalLoanCommandHandler' that handles the undo disbursal command for loans within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the undo disbursal operation to 'LoanWritePlatformService'. The class is annotated as a Spring service and specifies a command type for processing.

classes.name: UndoDisbursalLoanCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles undo disbursal commands for loans, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and interacting with LoanWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to undo a loan disbursal, invoking the corresponding method on the LoanWritePlatformService.
